name: Sawyer Merritt
text:
BREAKING: Tesla has just announced that FSD V15 is now starting to roll out!

Here's what's new:
• 25x better handling of safety critical cases
• Tesla Reality View : Adds a live visualization of the drive that lets you see & control what FSD is planning to do.
• Navigation for start & end of the trip now learns end-to-end from fleet route preferences. Later v15 releases will expand this to the entire route.
•Better detection of signs, animals, debris, potholes and standing water, plus more natural speed handling in school zones and inclement weather.
• FSD can now slow for speed cameras & Bike Rack Mode lets you enable FSD w/ bike racks or similar hitch accessories

It's finally here!  https://x.com/Tesla/status/2124222447855743019/video/1
